original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

customer_context.original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

refined_analytical_task.decision: For each of 336 supplied products at stores, estimate recorded fulfilled unit demand, cover supplier lead time plus seven-day review, subtract usable stock and timely existing deliveries, apply safety stock and whole-unit pack/minimum rules, and flag shortages before arrivals.
refined_analytical_task.routine: Load and validate the four files; deduplicate transactions; normalize statuses; aggregate demand; fit selected method; project daily demand; calculate target stock and timed gaps; export positive and supported zero orders. Replaces repeating these arithmetic and file preparation steps; no exact incumbent or manual runtime was supplied.
refined_analytical_task.facts: 2025-11-30 stock snapshot; policy effective 2025-11-30; lead times 1-7 days; reviews seven days; unit denominators agree. Supplied operations are assumed scenario facts.
refined_analytical_task.interpretations: Completed, shipped and returned positive quantities represent gross recorded fulfillment attributed to order date. Include online and in-store records because all are assigned a Store_ID; no separate fulfillment-location mapping is supplied. A return is not evidence of usable returned inventory.
refined_analytical_task.unknowns: No customer incumbent, lost demand, historical stock availability, return-to-stock timing, historical status changes, independent evaluation outcomes, cost function or meaningful success threshold. Do not invent these.
refined_analytical_task.proxies: Recorded-unit absolute forecast error supports method comparison but cannot establish service availability, savings or cost optimality.
refined_analytical_task.scope: CPU-only conventional bounded predictive candidates; no operational policy redesign; no paid APIs during weekly execution; no December sales access. October-November comparisons are development evidence.
candidate_discovery_evidence: source_profile.json: 336 pairs, 17406 raw rows, 42 exact duplicates, sparse transactions across a complete global daily calendar
inspect_sources.py: quantity/status/return checks, recurring November-December elevation in prior years, 28 stable product-name mappings
input-1.csv: supplier lead plus review requires 8-14 days, in addition to next week
refined_analytical_task.workload_plan: Measure each candidate fit and inference including preparation via process high-water resident memory and elapsed time. Sparse one-hot effects and bounded training windows keep arrays small. Assess against 8 GB with OS headroom, without assuming host RAM equals 8 GB.
refined_analytical_task.unresolved_priorities: Availability versus excess stock is not specified. Apply supplied safety stock, no invented buffer, and expose lead-time risk and demand uncertainty.
refined_analytical_task.performance_gate: Cannot close: no externally predeclared meaningful improvement threshold or untouched outcomes. December remains reserved.
